classes.rule: Contact between road users followed by an abrupt change of motion: boxes first overlap after a fast approach, then within a short window one party brakes violently or is deflected. Start = contact; end = both stop or leave the frame.

A pair on a collision course (short time-to-contact while closing fast) where one party brakes hard or swerves, and the boxes never overlap. Start = onset of evasive action; end = the pair is apart and opening.
classes.status: Not output: 0 true / 14 false positives on our dev labels (tracker ID swaps, distant overlapping boxes).

classes.rule: Vehicle crosses a stop line from the approach side after its signal has been red for a grace period (amber-to-red runs are not flagged). Signal state comes from the lamp ROI, thresholded per video with Otsu.
classes.status: Not output: 0 / 1 - most signal heads face away from the camera.

classes.rule: Per observation, the learned direction field says what share of past traffic at that spot moved the same way. A sustained run of 'almost nobody drives like this here' on well-observed road is wrong-way driving.
The unwrapped heading of the moving part of a track rotates by about 180 degrees within a short window. Turns inside a u_turn_allowed polygon are legal and skipped.
classes.status: Not output: 0 / 7 - ID switches, and U-turns here look routine with no visible prohibition.

classes.rule: Stationary on the carriageway for at least 10 s, chained across tracker ID switches by location, and not part of a queue in a learned queue zone.
classes.status: Not output: 1 / 12 - signal queues and mid-junction waits look like stopped vehicles.

classes.rule: A pedestrian's ground point stays on observed road and outside every crossing polygon for a sustained time. Riders (person overlapping a two-wheeler or moving at vehicle speed) are rejected.
A vehicle passes through a crossing polygon while a pedestrian's ground point is inside the same (slightly enlarged) crossing. Start = vehicle enters; end = it leaves.
A vehicle passes through a prohibited (from-zone, to-zone) pair from the layout. Start = leaves the from-zone; end = settled in the to-zone.
The vehicle's ground point changes side of a solid marking polyline. Start = the wheel crosses; end = the centre is half a box width past the line.
During red, a vehicle comes to a stop already past the stop line but not inside the junction. Start = it stops; end = the signal turns green.

Vehicles grouped by dominant lane direction (from the direction field, so stopped cars keep their lane). A direction is congested when enough vehicles are present and their median size-normalised speed is a crawl, sustained.

Animals detected on the road, plus a background-change detector on 1 fps thumbnails: a short-term median that differs from the long-term background on the carriageway and is not explained by any tracked road user.
classes.status: Not output: 0 / 1 on the samples; kept in the code with a per-video, lighting-robust background.

classes.rule: Fire/smoke boxes from the fine-tuned detector above a confidence and size, required to persist across a sliding window so headlights, brake lights and glare do not trigger it.
